verdict.rationale: Kling publishes a per-unit USD price table for API generations (for example $0.35 for a 5-second pro image-to-video and $0.126 per second for standard motion control), so a marketer can work out the cost before running a generation. It also documents credit rules: failed generations consume no credits, and team plans have shared credits and centralized billing. There is no evidence of an in-product cost preview shown before you generate, or of a spend-tracking or usage dashboard afterwards. missing for 10: an in-app pre-generation credit/dollar estimate, a documented spend or usage history and analytics, budget or quota alerts, and independent hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a marketer, I can see what a generation will cost in credits or dollars before running it, and track spend afterwards

citations.quote: Pricing note: all prices below are USD per unit of generation.
